method: read-only transaction receipt + exact event match + block isolation + sender/recipient EVM-balance deltas
limitations: One configured PortalDot RPC was queried; the RPC operator was not independently authenticated.

The sender debit matches gasUsed × effectiveGasPriceWei and the recipient balance increase matches the TransferExecuted amount. The report does not break down the debit into runtime execution fee and refundable storage deposit components; see the upstream pallet-revive gas/deposit model and PortalDot runtime notes.
note: The isolated block contains only the target transaction; sender balance decrease matches gasUsed × effectiveGasPriceWei, and the expected recipient's balance increase matches the TransferExecuted amount.
costInterpretation: The sender's gross EVM balance decrease for this isolated transaction block is reconciled to gasUsed × effectiveGasPriceWei. Do not label the full amount as an irrecoverable gas-only fee: upstream pallet-revive gas-estimation documentation describes storage deposits as part of the required gas budget, and such deposits may be refundable. This report does not establish the exact execution-fee versus storage-deposit split for this PortalDot V3 runtime.
